name: vscode-eilmer
description: Hover docs, completions and diagnostics for Eilmer 5 (lmr) Lua input scripts, layered on the sumneko Lua language server.

commands.title: Eilmer: Regenerate API Dictionary from gdtk Source

eilmer.gdtkRepo.description: Path to the gdtk source repository. Empty means $DGD_REPO, then ~/gdtk.

eilmer.gdtkInstall.description: Path to the gdtk install (contains bin/lmr and lib/*.lua). Empty means $DGD, then ~/gdtkinst.

eilmer.settingsTarget.description: Where to write the Lua language server settings (Lua.workspace.library and diagnostic severities). "workspace" keeps them in the project's .vscode/settings.json (falls back to user settings when no folder is open); "global" applies them to every Lua file you edit.

eilmer.strictUndefined.description: Raise the Lua language server's undefined-global and undefined-field diagnostics to Error, so misspelt Eilmer functions and methods get red squiggles.

eilmer.diagnostics.enable.description: Check Eilmer-specific mistakes: unknown constructor keys, X.new{} instead of X:new{}, unknown config.* fields and invalid option strings.

eilmer.checkStaleness.description: On start-up, offer to regenerate the API dictionary when the gdtk repository has moved to a different revision.
